generation_method: Every schema is grounded in a real, already-existing shape in this repo (a checkpoint entry, an outcomes.jsonl line, a tool_router.py Row class, brand/company.json) -- see each entry's real_producer field. Where no real producer exists yet, status is 'defined_not_yet_produced' and real_producer is null, stated plainly rather than implying a live source. The Agent object is a pointer to taxonomy/marketing_taxonomy.json, not a duplicate of it.

agent.name: Agent
agent.real_producer: taxonomy/marketing_taxonomy.json via .claude/lib/taxonomy_registry.py -- the real, live Agent Registry. Not redefined here; query that file/script for agent data.

brand.name: Brand
brand.purpose: Voice, positioning, identity, messaging, approved/prohibited claims
brand.real_producer: brand/voice_system.json + brand/icp_definition.md + brand/personas.json (brand-voice-extraction-subagent, core-brand-positioning-subagent) -- a composite of 3 files, each already owned/schemed by its producing sub-agent; not redefined here.

campaign.name: Campaign
campaign.purpose: Objective, audience, channels, assets, spend, results

content_asset.name: Content Asset
content_asset.purpose: Brief, format, channel, version, status, performance

customer_contact.name: Customer / Contact
customer_contact.real_producer: hubspot_connector.py / marketing-os-infra/04-hubspot-revenue-agent (read-only HubSpot contact properties); no dedicated Pydantic row class exists yet for contacts specifically -- only the deal-side (Opportunity) is currently typed.

event.name: Event
event.real_producer: marketing-os-infra/lib/tool_router.py row schemas + .claude/lib/trigger_registry.py internal condition evaluation.
event.schema_class: AdRow / GSCRow / SurveyResponseRow / ProductEventRow / MediaCoverageRow / SocialProfileSnapshotRow

learning.name: Learning
learning.purpose: Observed outcome converted into reusable knowledge

opportunity.name: Opportunity
opportunity.purpose: Pipeline stage, value, probability, sales context

organization.name: Organization
organization.purpose: Business identity, goals, markets, policies, constraints

task.name: Task
task.purpose: Atomic action, inputs, output, status, owner
task.real_producer: chief-marketing-orchestrator.md Step 5 dispatch contract, persisted verbatim in a checkpoint's `contracts` array.

tool.name: Tool
tool.real_producer: marketing-os-infra/lib/*_connector.py -- see TOOL_REGISTRY below, the real catalog this build generates.

workflow.name: Workflow
workflow.purpose: Trigger, states, steps, dependencies, approval rules
workflow.real_producer: workflows/*.md (4 real named workflows) + .claude/lib/trigger_registry.py (registered condition/cron triggers) -- composite, not a single file.
